name: tactus-videos
description: VideoML videos about the Tactus programming language

scripts.vml:render:intro: node $VIDEOML_CLI render --script src/videos/intro/intro.script.json --timeline src/videos/intro/intro.timeline.json --audio public/videoml/intro.wav --frames out/frames/intro --out out/intro.mp4 --browser-bundle $BABULUS_BUNDLE --browser-bundle public/browser-components.js
scripts.vml:render:why: node $VIDEOML_CLI render --script src/videos/why-a-new-language/why-a-new-language.script.json --timeline src/videos/why-a-new-language/why-a-new-language.timeline.json --audio public/videoml/why-a-new-language.wav --frames out/frames/why-a-new-language --out out/why-a-new-language.mp4 --browser-bundle $BABULUS_BUNDLE --browser-bundle public/browser-components.js
scripts.vml:render:all: npm run vml:render:intro && npm run vml:render:guardrails && npm run vml:render:why
